notes: No SVG qualifies: every Vagaro vector is the 'vagaro' wordmark (vagaro-logo-new.svg, /_next_assets/logos/logo.svg, the docs and Zendesk theme logos), and the only vector of the V, /_next_assets/favicon/safari-pinned-tab.svg, is a potrace auto-trace ('Created by potrace 1.14'). This 500x456 PNG is the bare V as vagaro.com shows it in its mobile header: transparent, no tile, red that reads on both themes (checked on the dark and light wells). The search's pick, the Vagaro Pro app icon (white V on a red-to-dark gradient tile), is the business app's tile; the bare mark is Vagaro's own logo and fits both apps.
